name: [UPD] Spider Tag!
desc:
⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻
In Spider Tag, you climb walls, tag people, or don't.

Customize with skins, hats, and colors.
Earn coins, find secrets, and get on the leaderboard.
⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻
᚛ Devices you can play on:
⦒ mobile phone
⦒ tablet
⦒ pc or laptop
⦒ console
⦒ virtual reality support works, but work in progress.
⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻
Premium users unlock a premium hat permanently.
if you buy VIP, you support the developers, get a skin, hat, and extra private server controls for even more fun!
⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻⸻
Spider Tag uses inverse kinematics for the advanced physics, and you can walk on walls, ceilings, and even below the map where there's a giant maze to explore, or check out the cave with glowing crystals!
